tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List all available Vayu UI components and hooks. Returns slug, name, category, description, and tags for each entry. Use type or category filters to narrow results.

category.description: Filter by category. Components: inputs, feedback, overlay, layout, data-display, navigation, animation, utility, media, forms. Hooks: state, lifecycle, dom, animation, sensor, side-effect, async, input.

tools.name: find_component
tools.description: Search for Vayu UI components and hooks by natural language query. Matches against name, description, tags, and use cases. Returns top 5 results with relevance reasons.

query.description: Natural language description of what you need, e.g. "floating dialog with overlay" or "debounce rapidly changing value"

type.description: Restrict results to components or hooks

tools.name: get_component_summary
tools.description: Get a lightweight identity card for a component or hook. Returns name, type, category, description, tags, use cases, sub-component names (components only), and counts of examples and anti-patterns. Use this after find_component to decide which detail tools to call next.

tools.name: get_component_props
tools.description: Get all props for a component including root props and sub-component props with types, defaults, descriptions, and accepted values.

tools.name: get_component_variants
tools.description: Get available visual variants and sizes for a component with their default values.

tools.name: get_component_states
tools.description: Get interactive and visual states for a component (loading, disabled, open, etc.) with their controlling props and default values.

tools.name: get_component_events
tools.description: Get event handlers for a component with full TypeScript signatures.

tools.name: get_component_a11y
tools.description: Get accessibility information for a component: ARIA roles, attributes, keyboard interactions, focus management, and WCAG compliance level.

tools.name: get_component_do_not
tools.description: Get anti-pattern rules for a component or hook — common mistakes with bad code, good code, and reasons. Use this to avoid generating incorrect usage.

tools.name: get_component_dependencies
tools.description: Get NPM dependencies, registry dependencies, and React peer dependency for a component or hook. Use this before scaffolding to know what packages to install.

tools.name: get_component_peer_components
tools.description: Get frequently co-used components for a given component, with reasons why they are used together.

tools.name: get_component_composition
tools.description: Get the compound component structure for a component: root component name, sub-components with descriptions and props, and internal hooks used.

tools.name: get_component_example
tools.description: Get code examples for a component or hook. Without a tag filter, returns only example titles and descriptions (no code). With a tag, returns full code for matching examples.

tag.description: Filter examples by tag (e.g. "loading", "compound", "basic"). When omitted, returns titles and descriptions only.

tools.name: scaffold_component_usage
tools.description: Generate a minimal working code snippet for a component or hook with the specified configuration. Returns ready-to-paste TSX code, import statements, and required dependencies.

tools.name: get_hook_details
tools.description: Get full API details for a hook: TypeScript signature, parameters, return values, and dependencies. For code examples and anti-patterns, use get_component_example and get_component_do_not with the hook slug.

tools.name: get_design_tokens
tools.description: Get Vayu UI design tokens (semantic color names, radius, shadows, fonts, animations) with Tailwind utility classes. Use these tokens instead of hardcoded colors or pixel values.

group.description: Filter by token group: "color", "radius", "shadow", "font", "animation". When omitted, returns all groups.

tools.name: get_install_guide
tools.description: Get the exact CLI commands and import statements needed to install and use a component or hook. Returns vayu-ui add commands, npm install commands, and import statements. Call this before writing code to know what to install.
